visualCharacteristics.purpose: Credit card product tiles: optional offer badge strip, card art with annual fee caption, card name and description, icon feature list or offer box, Card details / Apply now CTAs and footnote links

contentPattern.structure: one row per product: optional first cell with a short badge text (e.g. Bonus Offer), a cell with the card art image and optional caption (annual fee), then a content cell with the card name heading, description paragraph, feature lists, link-only paragraphs for CTAs (Card details, Apply now) and footnote links

reuseGuidance: Default is a two-column detailed product listing. Use compact-four-columns(-2/-3/-4) for 4-up summary rows with small card art beside the name, compact-three-columns for 3-up, alt for stacked art-over-name tiles.
